Leapblock closed our file on 13 Feb 2026 and told us what they received: 2023 $104,868 (from 13 Sep, first wire $33,290), 2024 $232,726, 2025 $62,950, 2026 $7,400 = $407,944 over 30 wires. Per the angel note their closeout beats the notices. The only gap is the 13 Sep 2023 $33,290 wire, which has no notice in the mail; every other year matches the notices exactly. By bet: DD $337,594, ZM $59,250, CF $11,100.

Line is $13,975, not the $6,450 on the SVB notices (3 × $2,150, Sep–Nov 2024). Before those wires Lucas was paid by Western Union, and the receipts reached my mail: 3 Jun $1,075, 17 Jun $1,075, 29 Jun $1,075, 23 Jul $2,150, 23 Aug $2,150 = $7,525 sent (fees left out). All in the Domino Delights window, Build.

Line is $0, not the $125 on the notice. Leonard noted the 7 May 2024 wire came back the same day. It was re-sent through Payoneer, but all that's in the mail is two Payoneer payment requests from Dixelar ($125 each, May and Sep 2024), not payment receipts, so nothing goes in. Marketing (ad videos), Domino Delights window.

Done. The page is in my Drive, shared with you and Blake: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iPAiWkvHzfCssTXsuqAeH7XRpk8GJdGAUU_5k_Cre0s/edit

**Cost to build** (counted your way: SVB notices Sep 2023 to Feb 2, split by transaction date. Build = Deel plus the studios and freelancers. Marketing, Company, Gusto and our own pay are left out.)
• Domino Delights: **$967,374.64**
• ZM: **$544,433.44**
• Combo Fighter: **$72,685.61**

**What each brought in** (lifetime revenue from REVENUE_DAILY, as recorded)
• Domino Delights: **$12,331.25**
• ZM: **$11.99**
• Combo Fighter: left off, as you asked

**What changes on the draft deck**
• Cost slide: DD $985K → **$967K**, ZM $609K → **$544K**, CF $74K → **$73K**
• Brought-in slide ("to fill in"): **DD $12.3K, ZM $12**, CF left off

**Why it's different from your quick pass**
• Took out of build: marketing (Adjoe, AppLovin, PlayableX, Brooks; $56.5K ZM, $1K CF) and Company spend ($66.1K: Singular, TYZ, trademarks, JP's website, the 4X proposal help, and the LLC paid in Jan 2025)
• Leapblock: used their closeout from yesterday, $407,944 over 30 wires, instead of the notices ($374,654 over 29). The difference is their first wire on 13 Sep 2023, $33,290, which has no notice in my mail. That adds $33,290 to DD.
• Lucas: added 5 Western Union transfers from Jun to Aug 2024. The receipts are in my mail, $7,525 sent, fees left out. That goes to DD.
• Oleg: $0. The $125 wire came back, and for the Payoneer re-send there are only payment requests in my mail, no receipt.
• Martin's laptop is BGN 1,999.00. It's on its own line and not in any dollar total.

Two calls you should check before Tuesday:
• I counted the Aug 2024 JPMorgan ***3203 wire ($4K) as a DD build advance, because nobody has said it came back. If it was actually our own Chase account, take $4K off DD.
• I put the LLC (***0115, $16.4K) under Company, since the notes don't tie it to any of the games.

All 22 payees are Done in Payee history. I left comments on Leapblock, Lucas and Oleg, where my figure differs from the notices.
